result:
I wrote the four answers to `answer.json`. The only change in the folder is that new file; the repository itself is untouched.

| Key | Answer | How I found it |
|---|---|---|
| `parse_config_added_in` | `c78c29df311f…` ("Read the config file", by Alice) | This commit adds `export function parseConfig(text)` in `src/config.js`. A later commit, "Note on parseConfig", also mentions the name, but the function already existed by then. |
| `legacy_deleted_in` | `4e1973b40d92…` ("Clean up old code") | This is the only commit that deletes `src/legacy.js`. |
| `most_changed_file` | `src/routes.js` | 20 commits changed it. The next highest is `src/server.js` with 9. |
| `lines_added_by_carol` | 73 | This is the total of added lines across all 19 of Carol Example's commits. She appears under only one name and email, so nothing needed merging. |
